subject: Private deployment technical sync — calendar update & scope check
body:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@finsecurebank.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finsecurebank.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment review — scope & proposed slots

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We are preparing an architecture review with our infra and security teams to confirm VPC connectivity, KMS/HSM options, and air-gapped deployment constraints. High level ask:

- Walk us through a candidate VPC peering model (or private link) and expected network egress patterns.
- KMS/HSM integrations and key lifecycle controls for on-prem/private installs.
- Options for air-gapped installations and what evidence/configuration we should expect (installation media, offline license, audit logs).

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive next week? Our team is available: Tue/Wed 11:00–13:00 or 15:00–17:00 PT. If any of those windows work for you please propose a firm time and send the invite.

I've attached the current architecture sketch and our SOW draft for context.

Attachments: architecture-draft.pdf (pdf), sow-finsecure.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Sr. Cloud Security Engineer
FinSecure Bank

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@finsecurebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment review — scope & proposed slots

Hi Alice — thanks for the materials, they look helpful. We'd like to make this a working session with network diagrams and a small checklist for the audit team. Proposed plan:

- 60 minutes + 15 minutes buffer (we'll keep to 75)
- Suggested time: Wed, Mar 3, 2027 10:00–11:15 PT (ok for our infra, will include the architect and security lead)
- Attendees from Redwood: Karthik (solutions), Marissa (infra lead), Lauren (security/compliance), Soojin (delivery)

I've uploaded a draft network diagram and a short agenda to the Confluence page linked below. Please let me know if the Wed 10:00 slot works or if you prefer one of your suggested windows.

Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Private+Deployment+FinSecure
Attachments: network-diagram.vsdx (Visio)

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

-----
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finsecurebank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice@finsecurebank.com>, FinSecure Security Team <security@finsecurebank.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment review — scope & proposed slots

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the quick turnaround. Wed 10:00 would have been ideal but we just got pulled into an audit prep exercise. Could we move to Thu, Mar 4, 2027 at 14:00–15:15 PT instead? That slot keeps our architects available.

Couple of pre-call asks from security:
- Can you provide a concise list of inbound/outbound ports and IPs we should plan to allow?
- For air-gapped installs: is there an option for on-site-only deployment vs shipping an appliance? If on-site is required, what lead time is typical?

No attachments from us. If you can confirm Thu 14:00 I'll circulate the invite internally.

Best,
Raj Patel
Director, Infrastructure Security
FinSecure Bank

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finsecurebank.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice@finsecurebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment review — scope & proposed slots

Raj / Alice — Thu Mar 4, 14:00–15:15 PT works for us. I've created a calendar invite and added the Redwood attendees. Link below.

Short pre-read checklist we've put together (we'll cover these in the first 15 minutes):
- Expected external endpoints and IP ranges to allow (will share a one-page allowlist PDF by EOD tomorrow).
- KMS/HSM options: customer-managed KMS via cloud KMS + HSM connector; on-prem HSM integration patterns (we'll bring specifics).
- Air-gap options: downloadable install bundle vs. on-prem appliance; typical lead times: 2–6 weeks depending on compliance packaging.
- Required evidence: examples of audit logs, retention settings, and a sample runbook for incident response.

Please confirm any additional stakeholders you want on the invite. Also, if your team needs an NDA/POC MSA prior to discussing certain details, note that now and I will loop Legal.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=secure-deploy-sync-finsecure
Confluence agenda: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Private+Deployment+FinSecure
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/FSB-2027-089

Attachments referenced: architecture-draft.pdf, network-diagram.vsdx, sow-finsecure.docx

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
